repository.scope: Numerical consistency, reproducibility, dependency boundaries and workspace integrity; not aerodynamic, biological or manuscript validation.

review: Control review distinguished plant calcium/electrical signaling from proposed neurons and local animal motor organization; clarified continuous hydrated service strands between spaced nodes and the gas-exchange/water-retention requirement.

Lifecycle review checked protected growth sites, renewal under load, regeneration limits, pressure breaks, nutrient resorption and distinct furling, retrieval and release operations; clarified externally sourced nutrient imports.
Mechanics review checked variable-gravity head and retrieval lower bounds, constant-torque requirements and the parent hash boundary; added rejection of negative and nonfinite retained water.

Root integration reconciled the prose with the actual scalar tissue-renewal calculation: tissue-specific composition and emergency-loss rates are requirements for a later model, not implemented outputs.
Shared constants are recorded by used name and value, with no whole-file hash that would invalidate the product when unrelated constants are added.
Final independent source/control audit found no material error in the signal arithmetic or interpretation of Mimosa, Nanomia, Hydra, flytrap and clonal-plant evidence.
remaining: No dynamic airfoil, membrane, cable or local-controller simulation; the old prescribed lift sign and coefficients remain conditional.
No calibrated neural, hydraulic, contractile or structural tissue; no empirically demonstrated kilometre service pathway.
No complete development, component metabolism, night reserves, nutrient recovery, ecological benefit or population budget.
Source access varies; no claim of complete scholarly reading, empirical validation, manuscript review or exact-build PDF review.
